hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; [[ "$f" == *.py ]] && ruff format "$f" && ruff check --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; }

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.css|*.json) command -v biome >/dev/null 2>&1 && biome check --write --unsafe "$f" 2>/dev/null;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; [[ "$f" == *.py ]] || exit 0; case "$f" in */packages/core/*) td="tests/unit/core/$(echo "$f" | sed 's|.*/packages/core/narrare_core/||' | cut -d/ -f1)";; */apps/api/*) td="tests/unit/api";; */tests/*) td="$(dirname "$f")";; *) exit 0;; esac; [[ -d "$td" ]] && pytest -q "$td" 2>/dev/null || true; }
git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && code-review-graph status --repo "/workspace" || echo 'Not a git repo, skipping'
